title: Rumored GTA 6 Lucia Actress Goes Viral After Dodging Fan Comments
description: Manni L. Perez, rumored to play Lucia in GTA 6, has gone viral after skillfully dodging a swarm of fan comments during a recent livestream.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rumored GTA 6 Lucia Actress Goes Viral in Recent Livestream

As the gaming world eagerly anticipates the arrival of Grand Theft Auto VI, every minor detail, rumor, and community reaction continues to capture massive attention. Recently, Manni L. Perez—the actress long rumored to portray the iconic female protagonist Lucia in GTA 6—has gone viral after successfully dodging a relentless swarm of comments from Grand Theft Auto fans during a live broadcast.

According to reports from IGN Games, Perez found herself at the center of a massive wave of fan interactions during a recent livestream. As followers flooded the chat with questions and references regarding GTA 6 and the heavily anticipated character Lucia, the actress deftly navigated around the commentary. The clip quickly gained traction across the internet, drawing widespread attention from a community hungry for any connection to Rockstar Games' upcoming masterpiece.

### The Immense Hype Surrounding Lucia

As the first primary female protagonist in the modern era of the franchise, Lucia has been a focal point for fans ever since the initial trailer release. The anticipation surrounding her character has led to intense scrutiny of casting rumors, with Manni L. Perez's name frequently tied to the role by eager sleuths across various platforms.

While official confirmations regarding the exact cast remain under wraps, the sheer volume of engagement on Perez's livestream highlights the unprecedented level of cultural impact GTA 6 holds even before its release.

### Editor's Take

Manni L. Perez's smooth handling of the fan onslaught during her livestream demonstrates both her composure and the unstoppable hype train surrounding GTA 6. While the casting remains unconfirmed, incidents like this show just how deeply invested the community is in every single facet of the game's development.
